claims.quote: differential diagnosis of left lower quadrant tenderness is challenging when left-sided acute appendicitis occurs, and it includes diverticular disease, primary epiploic appendagitis, acute pancreatitis, mesenteric ischemia, but also genitourinary tract disorders like pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), ovarian torsion, ectopic pregnancy, epididymitis, prostatitis, testicular torsion, cystitis
